deadline.value: International applicants: January 31, 2027 for September 2027 (the only intake for internationals).
deadline.quote: The deadline for international applicants for September 2027 is January 31st, 2027.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test applies; the GRE is not a departmental requirement.

supervisor.value: International applicants must contact a potential supervisor, who must confirm in writing before the application is reviewed.
supervisor.quote: International students must contact a potential supervisor prior to the application being reviewed. The faculty member will then provide written confirmation

funding.value: PhD students are guaranteed salary support for four years.
funding.quote: Ph.D. students are guaranteed salary support for four years.

entry_route.value: The PhD expects an MSc with at least a B+; you can apply while finishing the MSc.
entry_route.quote: for Ph.D. degree requirements: distinction in previous M.Sc. graduate courses equivalent to at least a McMaster University B+ average

also.quote: If you have not yet completed a two-year M.Sc. degree, you can still apply to our Ph.D. program

gre_general.value: The GRE is not a departmental requirement, though you may submit scores.
gre_general.quote: At present, it is not a departmental regulation.
